quotes.name: Raging Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

quotes.name: Remodel
quotes.flavor:
6 PM (23) This Old Grove 98055
A rusted masticore makes a beautiful addition to any garden.

quotes.name: Maddening Cacophony
quotes.flavor: You will forget, and it will be wonderful.

quotes.name: Sigiled Starfish
quotes.flavor: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

quotes.name: Liquimetal Torque
quotes.flavor:
"Weaponized jewelry has a long and respected history."
—Ervos Trax

quotes.name: Merchant Raiders
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "Tell you what, you keep the rope."

quotes.name: Ironroot Treefolk
quotes.flavor: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Spined Wurm
quotes.flavor:
"I wouldn't stand in front of that wurm, son. 'Course, I wouldn't stand behind it neither. In fact, standing anywhere near that wurm's not much of a plan. Running, now *that's* a plan!"
—Wandering mage

quotes.name: Looming Hoverguard
quotes.flavor: Although mute, hoverguards get their message across loud and clear.

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: This is the Sealed Gate... Beyond there is the esper world.

quotes.name: Talas Warrior
quotes.flavor: The sea is in their blood. Literally.

quotes.name: Puresteel Paladin
quotes.flavor: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

quotes.name: Goblin Chainwhirler
quotes.flavor: "The trick is, once you get moving, don't stop!"

quotes.name: Branching Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Lightning lives in everything, in living flesh and growing things. It must be set free."
—Rakka Mar

quotes.name: Slipstream Eel
quotes.flavor: "It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

quotes.name: Aang, Air Nomad
quotes.flavor: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.

quotes.name: Tinker
quotes.flavor:
"I wonder how it feels to be bored."
—Jhoira, artificer

quotes.name: Riot Piker
quotes.flavor: He doesn't care whether he's rioting about trade rights or just having a drunken brawl. He wakes up every morning eager to smash some heads.

quotes.name: Gnarled Mass
quotes.flavor:
"On the fifty-seventh day of the Battle of Silk, the bell again tolled in hopes of summoning mortal aid. This time, a new breed of kami rose to answer its call."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Conduit of Storms // Conduit of Emrakul
quotes.flavor: It strikes with the fury of a tempest.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor:
"Pain clears the mind of evil thoughts and allows them to better comprehend the glory of the Master."
—Father Lasher

quotes.name: Flooded Grove
quotes.flavor: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

quotes.name: Caustic Rain
quotes.flavor:
"Looking out the great windows of Vitu-Ghazi at the foundry stacks belching their smoke to the sky, I wonder when the sky will take its vengeance."
—Heruj, Selesnya initiate

quotes.name: Witch's Familiar
quotes.flavor: Some bog witches practice the strange art of batrachomancy, reading portents in the number, size, and color of warts on a toad's hide.

quotes.name: Mutagenic Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Sympathy is for weaklings. Whoever survives, wins."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

quotes.name: Vectis Gloves
quotes.flavor: Thieves love technological innovations almost as much as artificers do.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

quotes.name: Darksteel Angel
quotes.flavor: An alloy of curiosity and hope; the caretaker of a gleaming plane of possibility.

quotes.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
quotes.flavor: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

quotes.name: Crimson Hellkite
quotes.flavor:
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior."
—Rashida Scalebane

quotes.name: Living Tsunami
quotes.flavor: At low tide it slumbers. At high tide it devours.

quotes.name: Patron Wizard
quotes.flavor: "The best way to teach is by example."

quotes.name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
quotes.flavor: "Impress me."

quotes.name: Cycle of Life
quotes.flavor: Thus does nature assert herself.

quotes.name: Reckless Scholar
quotes.flavor: Progress comes at a price.

quotes.name: Goblin War Paint
quotes.flavor: War paint made from kolya fruit heightens senses and lessens fear. Unfortunately, fear is usually what keeps you alive.

quotes.name: Extinction
quotes.flavor:
"I once had an entire race killed just to listen to the rattling of their dried bones as I waded through them."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Snare the Skies
quotes.flavor: A hunter's precision and a durkvine's strength are a potent combination.

quotes.name: Military Intelligence
quotes.flavor: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

quotes.name: Tuinvale Treefolk // Oaken Boon
quotes.flavor: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

quotes.name: Abstruse Appropriation
quotes.flavor:
"Kozilek experiences reality on his own terms."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

quotes.name: Grove of the Burnwillows
quotes.flavor: Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.

quotes.name: Stampede Surfer
quotes.flavor: "This little piggy goes to war!"

quotes.name: Organic Extinction
quotes.flavor:
"Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing."
—Arima, lead inventor of the Futurists

quotes.name: Wall of Air
quotes.flavor: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

quotes.name: Providence
quotes.flavor: There is power in prayer, regardless of who is listening.

quotes.name: Shanodin Dryads
quotes.flavor: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

quotes.name: Demystify
quotes.flavor: "The River Heralds carve spells into jade, hoping to steer us from our course. But what right do they have to keep us from that which once was ours?"

quotes.name: Buzzard-Wasp Colony
quotes.flavor: What doesn't survive the Si Wong Desert assures that the buzzard-wasps do.

quotes.name: Aboshan, Cephalid Emperor
quotes.flavor: "No one can fight the tide forever."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Sealed Fate
quotes.flavor: It's good to know more about your enemy's fate than your enemy does.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Emerald Dragon // Dissonant Wave
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.

quotes.name: Battle-Rage Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Since when is it cheating to give one side an unfair advantage?"
—Braids

quotes.name: Malfegor
quotes.flavor: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

quotes.name: Gamble
quotes.flavor: When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

quotes.name: Elder Land Wurm
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's best to let sleeping dragons lie.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Pulse of Murasa
quotes.flavor: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this, your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

quotes.name: Enter the Infinite
quotes.flavor: There is no knowledge that is not power.

quotes.name: Combat Professor
quotes.flavor: "Before Yovus was cut down at Pranticle Peak, she performed which maneuver? Anyone? From the reading?"

quotes.name: Alluring Scent
quotes.flavor: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

quotes.name: Scarecrone
quotes.flavor: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

quotes.name: Imaginary Pet
quotes.flavor: "It followed me home. Can I keep it?"

quotes.name: Eliminate the Competition
quotes.flavor: Open hostilities are strictly forbidden at the Inventors' Fair, but "accidents" still happen.

quotes.name: Berserkers of Blood Ridge
quotes.flavor: They take a blood oath to die in battle. So far none have failed to fulfill the promise.

quotes.name: Enlightened Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

quotes.name: Simoon
quotes.flavor: Hot wind whipped up as if the weather itself wanted to fight Phyrexians.

quotes.name: Katara, the Fearless
quotes.flavor: "I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!"

quotes.name: Valakut Predator
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever volcanoes dream of, it seems like they always wake up grumpy."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Gird for Battle
quotes.flavor:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

quotes.name: Disrupt Decorum
quotes.flavor: *Strixhaven Star* food critic Aspen Van Gnoot's coverage of the fight would go on to win a student journalism award for outstanding war reporting.

quotes.name: Timberpack Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"The need for the pack is bred in their bones. Their true strength will not show itself for any other purpose."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "I know these waters better than you know yourselves."

quotes.name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
quotes.flavor: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

quotes.name: Acorn Catapult
quotes.flavor: The Kalonian word for "ammunition" is the same as the word for "bait."

quotes.name: Six-y Beast
quotes.flavor: Is it six?

quotes.name: Desperate Farmer // Depraved Harvester
quotes.flavor: Once he'd tasted that dark power, there was no turning back.

quotes.name: Shimmering Grotto
quotes.flavor:
"This is the price of being last in the food chain. We must keep our places of beauty hidden away instead of displayed for all to see."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

quotes.name: Hovermyr
quotes.flavor: Originally created to harvest blinkmoths, the hovermyr are now the silent observers of a dying world.

quotes.name: Man-o'-War
quotes.flavor:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

quotes.name: Hithlain Knots
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"If you will try to run away you must be tied; but we don't wish to hurt you."
—Sam

quotes.name: Commander's Plate
quotes.flavor: Armor changes, but Iron Man endures.

quotes.name: Prismatic Ending
quotes.flavor:
「アルカイックは、アルケヴィオスの終焉をもって初めて死に至るという人がいます。アルカイックの死は、次元の終わりの先触れだという人もいます。真実はどうなのかって？時が満ちれば自ずとわかりますよ。」
――アルケヴィオスの神託者、ジャズィ

quotes.name: Stirring Bard
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: At the first sign of danger, she breaks out the power chords.

quotes.name: Stolen by the Fae
quotes.flavor: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

quotes.name: Goblin Negotiation
quotes.flavor: Either you pay for Krenko's "protection" or you pay to replace your stall. Either way, you pay.

quotes.name: Overgrown Tomb
quotes.flavor: The elf was disgusted by the bramble before him when the skies darkened, then he stepped closer to observe the wild beauty.

quotes.name: Battering Craghorn
quotes.flavor: Their skeletons can be found all over Skirk Ridge, tangled in each other's horns.

quotes.name: Beaming Defiance
quotes.flavor:
"I've lived too long in my father's shadow. It's time to find my own light."
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

quotes.name: Tajic, Blade of the Legion
quotes.flavor: "I run the maze alone, but I fight with the full might of the Legion."

quotes.name: Withstand
quotes.flavor:
"Defense is as much a part of war as offense, the shield as important a tool as the sword."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Frazzled Editor
quotes.flavor: The pen is mightier than the sword.

quotes.name: Dwarven Catapult
quotes.flavor:
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Hornswoggle
quotes.flavor: Being a merciful pirate, she saved the vampire's gold from falling overboard.

quotes.name: Perennation
quotes.flavor: The Abzan believe in perennation—death is not only an end, but a return to the beginning.

quotes.name: Maraleaf Pixie
quotes.flavor: Neither hostile nor friendly, pixies flit through the forest seeking the treasures of the wilds.

quotes.name: Blind Creeper
quotes.flavor: It shuns everything except its next meal.

quotes.name: Roots
quotes.flavor:
"That which nourishes can also bind."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

quotes.name: Curse of Inertia
quotes.flavor:
"As long as I pull the strings, you will dance."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Clock of Omens
quotes.flavor: Those near the clock don't hear it anymore, but their every movement is in time with its ticking.

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Steel Overseer
quotes.flavor:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

quotes.name: Lathril, Blade of the Elves
quotes.flavor: "Stance ready. Strike true."

quotes.name: Temporal Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All of her classmates have disappeared."
—Tolarian renegade

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor:
"Trying to meet a worthy man in the wrong way is as bad as closing the door on an invited guest."
—Mencius, a Chinese philosopher

quotes.name: Edgar, King of Figaro
quotes.flavor: "Sabin...let's settle this with the toss of a coin."

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

quotes.name: Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
quotes.flavor: "Rikku-approved item coming up!"

quotes.name: Hordeling Outburst
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

quotes.name: Tolarian Kraken
quotes.flavor:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

quotes.name: The Haunt of Hightower
quotes.flavor: It drains vitality from those it touches.

quotes.name: Karn's Bastion
quotes.flavor:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

quotes.name: Fog
quotes.flavor:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

quotes.name: Briarberry Cohort
quotes.flavor: A clique can cause far more mischief than one faerie on its own.

quotes.name: Hero's Downfall
quotes.flavor: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.

quotes.name: Twilight Mire
quotes.flavor: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

quotes.name: Marauding Sphinx
quotes.flavor: She poses a riddle to each mark, allowing them a chance to keep their goods. Thus far, none have succeeded.

quotes.name: Trailblazer's Boots
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it feels like the whole world is singing along with Miku.

quotes.name: Riftsweeper
quotes.flavor: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

quotes.name: Triumphant Reckoning
quotes.flavor: "We have defied fate. Our destinies are our own."

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Smash to Smithereens
quotes.flavor: The giant Tarvik dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe. When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

quotes.name: Twinflame Tyrant
quotes.flavor:
"Job only paid enough for one head. I'm out."
—Peren, veteran mercenary

quotes.name: Protomatter Powder
quotes.flavor:
"There is no such thing as scrap metal. All such material can be repaired with the proper bonding agent."
—Quennus, metallurgeon

quotes.name: Veil of Birds
quotes.flavor: When wind marries sky, even the bride's veil sings her praises.

quotes.name: Rakka Mar
quotes.flavor:
"The finest pawns are those with pawns of their own."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Aura Fracture
quotes.flavor: Jamuraa's rhystic mages treat magic as their garden, uprooting unwanted spells as bothersome weeds.

quotes.name: Relentless Rats
quotes.flavor: If you revere them, they grow insidious.

quotes.name: Madcap Skills
quotes.flavor: The larger the crowd, the harder it is for them to run away.

quotes.name: Mausoleum Guard
quotes.flavor: "Ghoulcallers trying to get in, geists trying to get out . . . . This duty is never dull."

quotes.name: Emancipation Angel
quotes.flavor: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

quotes.name: Carrion Ants
quotes.flavor: "War is no picnic," my father liked to say. But the ants seemed to disagree.

quotes.name: Springbloom Druid
quotes.flavor: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

quotes.name: Shelter
quotes.flavor: From the storm of hellfire, the angel emerged, smiling.

quotes.name: Blood Celebrant
quotes.flavor:
"Their blood is the nectar that nourishes the Cabal."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
quotes.flavor: Pippin thought he saw groves of trees moving. Could it be that the trees of Fangorn were awake, and the forest was rising, marching over the hills to war?

quotes.name: Bonecaller Cleric
quotes.flavor: "My blood was never my own. I carried it gladly for the Hungering One, and at last she arises to reclaim it."

quotes.name: Encroaching Wastes
quotes.flavor: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.

quotes.name: Morselhoarder
quotes.flavor: It scours the hills for living matter, savoring even the tang of poisonous fungi.

quotes.name: Void Rend
quotes.flavor: Stagecoach Encounters One More Magical Vortex than Expected

quotes.name: Karametra's Favor
quotes.flavor: The harvest god's cornucopia contains the fruits of the fields, the forest, and beyond.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: An official seal authenticating her identity as a very good girl.

quotes.name: Sultai Emissary
quotes.flavor: To the Sultai, Ugin's power was just one more resource to be exploited.

quotes.name: Aggressive Sabotage
quotes.flavor: Squee's orders basically came down to "attack the squishy parts."

quotes.name: Din of the Fireherd
quotes.flavor: Vengeance in stampede form.

quotes.name: Jedit Ojanen
quotes.flavor: Mightiest of the Cat Warriors, Jedit Ojanen forsook the forests of his tribe and took service with the Robaran Mercenaries, rising through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.

quotes.name: Killing Wave
quotes.flavor: "Try again in the next life, darling."

quotes.name: Durkwood Boars
quotes.flavor:
"And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine: and the herd ran violently . . . ."
—*The Bible*, Mark 5:13

quotes.name: Squirrel Sovereign
quotes.flavor: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .

quotes.name: Oviya Pashiri, Sage Lifecrafter
quotes.flavor: "Inspiration is reciprocal: we all have a responsibility to each other to create."

quotes.name: Fickle Efreet
quotes.flavor: Flame chooses its own course.

quotes.name: Dromosaur
quotes.flavor: They say dromosaurs are frightened of dogs, even little ones. There are no dogs in Shiv. Not even little ones.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Ill-Gotten Inheritance
quotes.flavor: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

quotes.name: Mana Leak
quotes.flavor: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

quotes.name: Mogg Raider
quotes.flavor: The evisceration of one mogg always cheers up the rest.

quotes.name: Jeskai Devotee
quotes.flavor: A master of the Whirling Blade technique, he did not hesitate to leap to the monastery's defense.

quotes.name: Promise of Loyalty
quotes.flavor: "It's us against the world. Forever."

quotes.name: Peri Brown
quotes.flavor: "I'm Perpugilliam Brown and I can shout just as loud as you can!"

quotes.name: Staff of the Sun Magus
quotes.flavor: A symbol of conviction in uncertain times.

quotes.name: Trophy Mage
quotes.flavor: "The tools of the past will help us forge the future."

quotes.name: Essence Flux
quotes.flavor: A spirit is both fettered and free—bound in some ways to its previous existence, yet able to transcend much of the corporeal.

quotes.name: Qiqirn Merchant
quotes.flavor: Small Beastmen that live alongside humans in the Aht Urhgan Empire. Their ancestors were nomads in the north, and their unique culture and customs can be seen even now.

quotes.name: Regal Caracal
quotes.flavor: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

quotes.name: Thermo-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

quotes.name: Triceraton Regenta
quotes.flavor:
"I am meant to be the Triceraton Regenta, so I must fulfill my destiny and avenge my mother's death!"
—Seri

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: Knowledge is wasted if not shared.

quotes.name: Rings of Brighthearth
quotes.flavor: All that has been wrought by those who wield the Three will turn to their undoing, and their minds and hearts will become revealed to Sauron, if he regains the One.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor:
"An ordered Sothera is a peaceful Sothera. Join the Strategic Corps today and proudly turn the gears of progress!"
—Pinnacle recruitment ad

quotes.name: Undercity Eliminator
quotes.flavor: With their guild shunned for opening the doors to Phyrexia, some among the Golgari embraced their status as pariahs and took out their bitterness on all who crossed their paths.

quotes.name: Guiding Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Retainer of eternal Sun! Life flash again upon thy wings."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

quotes.name: Copper Myr
quotes.flavor: The elves thought of the myr as minor threats, just as the myr thought of the elves.

quotes.name: Field Creeper
quotes.flavor: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

quotes.name: Blast of Genius
quotes.flavor: Ral Zarek's brainstorms bring actual thunder and lightning.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Used carefully, material has been exposed to the baleful energies of the Warp can be contained to fuel powerful rituals.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

quotes.name: Blood Artist
quotes.flavor:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

quotes.name: Venom Sliver
quotes.flavor: The venom softens tissue and liquefies internal organs, allowing the slivers to feed freely without wasting time chewing.

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.flavor: You're on your way home when you spot the gates of a strange city . . . one that isn't on the map and wasn't here when you traveled this path four days ago.

quotes.name: Dread Statuary
quotes.flavor: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

quotes.name: Accomplished Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Tincture of murkroot and lizard feet? Simple. One that doesn't taste like murkroot and lizard feet? I'm working on it."

quotes.name: Consume Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Youth is wasted on the young. So I help myself to some of it from time to time."
—Sifa Grent

quotes.name: Volcanic Dragon
quotes.flavor: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

quotes.name: Stone Giant
quotes.flavor: What goes up, must come down.

quotes.name: Flamewave Invoker
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.flavor:
"Do not think that only by singing amid the trees, nor even by the slender arrows of Elven- bows, is this land of Lothlórien maintained and defended against its Enemy."
—Galadriel

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: "I am the primordial guardian of an ancient glade. Please help me find it."

quotes.name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
quotes.flavor: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.

quotes.name: Honored Knight-Captain
quotes.flavor: "Hope can never fade so long as there's a hand to carry my sword when I fall."

quotes.name: Pit Keeper
quotes.flavor: "The undead are not 'awakened.' They are evicted when there is no room left in the pit for more bodies."

quotes.name: Dismember
quotes.flavor:
「苦痛、苦悩、不浄、恐怖、肉体を剥ぎ捨てよ。それらを明け渡せば、一つとなって祝福を受けるだろう。」
――「ファイレクシアの聖句」

quotes.name: Valorous Stance
quotes.flavor:
"Vibranium can absorb, and it can also reflect."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Dread Return
quotes.flavor: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

quotes.name: Soul Channeling
quotes.flavor: Driven by masters more terrible than the Mercadians could imagine, the dark overseers would pay any price to keep their shipwrights working.

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "Considering your statures, let's start with the upward slash."

quotes.name: Dawnwing Marshal
quotes.flavor: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."

quotes.name: Kavu Climber
quotes.flavor:
"There was a crack of branches, a rustle of leaves, then a tremendous roar. Our party had no chance as death descended from above."
—Taseen, elvish bard

quotes.name: Bedlam
quotes.flavor: Sometimes quantity, in the absence of quality, is good enough.

quotes.name: Leonin Vanguard
quotes.flavor: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

quotes.name: Iroas's Blessing
quotes.flavor: The blessing is not the strength itself, but the knowledge of how to use it.

quotes.name: Mighty Leap
quotes.flavor: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

quotes.name: Territorial Dispute
quotes.flavor: Bit by bit, Mercadia City had forced the Cho-Arrim from their ancestral lands. They would be pushed no further.

quotes.name: Arcane Encyclopedia
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: A quill from the First Reader at Candlekeep, the spectacles of the Most Holy Servant of Gond, a woven bookmark from the Caleph Arcane of Calimport: readers always leave something of themselves behind.

quotes.name: Granitic Titan
quotes.flavor:
"That one's not mine. Run!"
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Angelheart Vial
quotes.flavor: It holds a whisper from Iona: "Persevere."

quotes.name: Aetherplasm
quotes.flavor: Its fickle form holds hints of a thousand former identities.

quotes.name: Locust Spray
quotes.flavor:
"Captain, the cowards are throwing *bugs* at us!"
—Sphyr, Keelhauler lookout

quotes.name: Fungus Elemental
quotes.flavor:
I rot growth and grow rot. What am I?
—Elvish riddle

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Warship Scout
quotes.flavor: "For the glory of the Fire Nation!"

quotes.name: Lotus Guardian
quotes.flavor: Lotus fields are too valuable to leave undefended.

quotes.name: Shiko and Narset, Unified
quotes.flavor: For peace, lead by example.

quotes.name: Gixian Puppeteer
quotes.flavor: To some, desecration. To Gix, decoration.

quotes.name: Overflowing Basin
quotes.flavor: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

quotes.name: Tribune of Rot
quotes.flavor: "I bestow upon you a great honor—your flesh alone will nourish a new generation of saprolings."

quotes.name: Nearheath Stalker
quotes.flavor: "Do not speak of this to the elders. They look unfavorably upon my indulgences."

quotes.name: Enthralling Victor
quotes.flavor: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

quotes.name: Weirded Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"Emrakul makes apparent those whom she has favored."
—Runo Stromkirk

quotes.name: Citanul Woodreaders
quotes.flavor: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

quotes.name: Harmonic Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Wrecking Ball
quotes.flavor: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

quotes.name: Thoughtbind
quotes.flavor:
"As the rest of the mortal world waged war, Lady Azami and her students invaded tomes of knowledge. Their search yielded spells critical in the fight."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Raised by Giants
quotes.flavor: Your parents taught you that strength can be nurtured and honed, no matter one's size.

quotes.name: The Gaffer
quotes.flavor: On the growing of vegetables, especially potatoes, Master Hamfast Gamgee was recognized as the leading authority by all in the neighborhood.

quotes.name: Brain Freeze
quotes.flavor:
「すっごく恥ずかしかったんだから。ヴェイラン学部長に当てられた途端、もうなにも考えられなくて。頭の中は真っ白よ。」
――本の山が連なる書庫で耳にしたこと

quotes.name: Kemba, Kha Regent
quotes.flavor: "I am not Raksha. I never will be. But I refuse to be the kha who watched her pride be torn asunder."

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
quotes.flavor: Full of pluck, full of cunning, full of ground-up Eldrazi-powered goblin golem parts.

quotes.name: Strongarm Thug
quotes.flavor: "No, I insist—let *me* carry all that heavy jewelry."

quotes.name: Innocent Traveler // Malicious Invader
quotes.flavor: "Aren't you going to offer me a drink?"

quotes.name: Keening Apparition
quotes.flavor: Some souls are too damaged to be of use to the Orzhov.

quotes.name: Mystic Melting
quotes.flavor: The sun-hot glow radiated from the druids, leaving scattered metal in steaming pools as it passed.

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Galvanic Blast
quotes.flavor: "All units, set repulsors to maximum power!"

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Winged Coatl
quotes.flavor: The nacatl called this new species "vetli," their word for poison arrows.

quotes.name: Pelakka Predation // Pelakka Caverns
quotes.flavor:
"As a child, I was afraid of the dark. Now, I'm afraid of the things I know are lurking in the dark, waiting to bite my head off."
—Sneeflebrix, expedition rogue

quotes.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: "Immortality is my greatest burden."

quotes.name: Bane of Progress
quotes.flavor: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

quotes.name: Deathgreeter
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: "The bones of allies grant wisdom. The bones of enemies grant strength. The bones of dragons grant life eternal."

quotes.name: Mischievous Pup
quotes.flavor:
"Either he made a gnome very angry when he took that, or he'll make one very happy when he brings it back."
—Ihio, Oteclan market vendor

quotes.name: Hope of Ghirapur
quotes.flavor: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

quotes.name: Kroxa and Kunoros
quotes.flavor: When the Invasion Tree reached the Underworld, it found only teeth and fury.

quotes.name: Stingmoggie
quotes.flavor: A path vexed by the stingmoggie was probably the wrong path anyhow.

quotes.name: Living End
quotes.flavor:
「死とは贈り物。終わりの訪れを知る中に、安らぎがあるの。」
――「屍術に関するヴェスから忠告」

quotes.name: Marauding Looter
quotes.flavor: "I'll be taking that."

quotes.name: Karn's Bastion
quotes.flavor:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

quotes.name: Dragonmaster Outcast
quotes.flavor: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

quotes.name: Flaxen Intruder // Welcome Home
quotes.flavor: The middle blade was just right.

quotes.name: Shu Soldier-Farmers
quotes.flavor: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

quotes.name: Endless One
quotes.flavor: It embodies all possible meanings of the word "infinite."

quotes.name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
quotes.flavor: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

quotes.name: Grave Strength
quotes.flavor: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.

quotes.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
quotes.flavor: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

quotes.name: Agoraphobia
quotes.flavor: "Everyone in this city is choosing sides. I choose inside."

quotes.name: Soul Snare
quotes.flavor:
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Barter in Blood
quotes.flavor:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Octoprophet
quotes.flavor: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

quotes.name: Horned Kavu
quotes.flavor: "That didn't happen naturally," said Multani. "Rath's overlay is interfering with the Æther itself."

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Cruel Reality
quotes.flavor: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

quotes.name: Chub Toad
quotes.flavor:
Chub Toad, Chub Toad
At the door.
Run away quick
Or you'll run no more.
—Traditional children's rhyme

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Lightning Reflexes
quotes.flavor: "Inhale. Kill. Exhale."

quotes.name: Southern Elephant
quotes.flavor: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

quotes.name: Desperate Ravings
quotes.flavor: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

quotes.name: Smokebraider
quotes.flavor: "Be silent and listen to your inner fire. Only then can you walk the Path of Flame."

quotes.name: Chieftain en-Dal
quotes.flavor: The clearest commands are practical examples.

quotes.name: Crazed Skirge
quotes.flavor: They are Phyrexia's couriers; the messages they carry are inscribed on their slick hides.

quotes.name: Command Beacon
quotes.flavor:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

quotes.name: Treespring Lorian
quotes.flavor: No matter your strength, the Krosan Forest is stronger. No matter your speed, the Wirewood Forest is faster.

quotes.name: Bag of Holding
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Leave no treasure behind.

quotes.name: Deathknell Berserker
quotes.flavor:
"Sven felled the elf with an arrow through the chest, but moments later, the corpse rose with a sneer to fight again."
—*Longbeard Saga*

quotes.name: Hard Evidence
quotes.flavor: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

quotes.name: Touch of the Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"Time is a vigilant tyrant, but there are those who have broken free of its gaze."
—Laikas, Erunian monk

quotes.name: Seton, Krosan Protector
quotes.flavor: "Survival of the fittest is not only the law of the pits, it is the law of nature. That is why I fight."

quotes.name: Ondu Inversion // Ondu Skyruins
quotes.flavor:
"At first rumble you'd best hold on tight and pray to any gods you still hold dear."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder

quotes.name: Goblin Fireleaper
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Let us hope that fire now lies between us and pursuit. Come! There is no time to lose."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Infantry Veteran
quotes.flavor: "Swords, to me! We must engage their line to protect our archers and mages. Let no one fail this task!"

quotes.name: Ash Barrens
quotes.flavor: The pleasant row of old Hobbit-holes in the bank on the north side of the Pool were deserted, and their little gardens that used to run down bright to the water's edge were rank with weeds.

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor:
"Zemo insults me by tasking me with weaklings such as you. Even together, you pose no challenge."
—Radioactive Man, Dr. Chen Lu

quotes.name: Affa Guard Hound
quotes.flavor: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

quotes.name: Jester's Cap
quotes.flavor:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Geralf's Messenger
quotes.flavor: The message is "Run."

quotes.name: Rootwalla
quotes.flavor: If you try to sneak up on a rootwalla, you'll suddenly find yourself dealing with twice the lizard.

quotes.name: Pulse of the Forge
quotes.flavor: Before wars or weapons, there was anger.

quotes.name: Goblin Warchief
quotes.flavor: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: "My family protects all families."

quotes.name: Hungry Ridgewolf
quotes.flavor: Even vampires know to travel faster when they hear howling in the Geier Reach passes.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

quotes.name: Electrodominance
quotes.flavor: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

quotes.name: Whirlwind Denial
quotes.flavor: "No, no, and ... no."

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Titania, Protector of Argoth
quotes.flavor: Beauty and strength in every season.

quotes.name: Wandering Archaic // Explore the Vastlands
quotes.flavor: "Fly the path of nine birds."

quotes.name: Scaled Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Surviving an encounter with it is proof enough that an initiate is ready for the Trial of Strength.

quotes.name: Loxodon Mender
quotes.flavor: The Auriok believe that in the hands of a loxodon, no weapon can be broken.

quotes.name: Loyal Apprentice
quotes.flavor: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

quotes.name: Dinosaur Hunter
quotes.flavor: "Aye, the foul beast chomped me, but I got away. You'd best believe when I find it again, it won't get away so easy."

quotes.name: Arvad the Cursed
quotes.flavor: "I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

quotes.name: Ridge Rannet
quotes.flavor:
"Only those with the strength to seize their destiny deserve to have one."
—Nacatl scratchforms

quotes.name: Early Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"Earth's increase, foison plenty,
Barns and garners never empty:
Vines with clust'ring bunches growing;
Plants with goodly burden bowing."
—William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

quotes.name: Containment Priest
quotes.flavor: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

quotes.name: Polyraptor
quotes.flavor: If you see one, you're already surrounded.

quotes.name: Battleflight Eagle
quotes.flavor: Eagles make fine mounts, but they're too proud to carry anyone for long.

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor: Idealism fits him better than his armor.

quotes.name: Disciple of Bolas
quotes.flavor: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

quotes.name: Sunscorch Regent
quotes.flavor:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Archangel of Thune
quotes.flavor: Even the wicked have nightmares.

quotes.name: Cunning Breezedancer
quotes.flavor:
"That which is beautiful in form can also be deadly."
—Ishai, Ojutai dragonspeaker

quotes.name: Thallid Soothsayer
quotes.flavor: Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.

quotes.name: Rosheen Meanderer
quotes.flavor: Night after night, Rosheen babbled about a bygone sunlit world, her every word dismissed as a madwoman's ravings.

quotes.name: Plate Spinning
quotes.flavor: For extra style points, spin them.

quotes.name: Mage's Attendant
quotes.flavor: Crime sometimes makes unlikely allies into lifelong friends.

quotes.name: Finishing Move
quotes.flavor: What the show lacks in historical accuracy, it makes up for in awesome submission holds.

quotes.name: Glint-Eye Nephilim
quotes.flavor: When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Advent of the Wurm
quotes.flavor: The consciousness of Mat'Selesnya does not always spread in peaceful ways.

quotes.name: Searslicer Goblin
quotes.flavor: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

quotes.name: Fairgrounds Trumpeter
quotes.flavor: The louder the elephant trumpeted, the more the crowd cheered. And the more the crowd cheered . . .

quotes.name: Go for the Throat
quotes.flavor: "Precious, precious, precious!"

quotes.name: Expressive Iteration
quotes.flavor:
「あなたが作り出すものは数多くの選択肢から生じた結果なのだ。自分の心に従え。そうすれば誤りを選びようがなくなる。」
――プリズマリの学部長、ナサーリ

quotes.name: Blessing of Frost
quotes.flavor: A friend of Jorn is never cold.

quotes.name: Sagu Archer
quotes.flavor: His arrows whistle like a serpent's hiss.

quotes.name: Wall of Air
quotes.flavor: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

quotes.name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
quotes.flavor: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

quotes.name: Order of Leitbur
quotes.flavor: Followers of Tourach regarded all other religions equally: with open contempt. Not so the followers of Leitbur, who made it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.

quotes.name: Bristling Boar
quotes.flavor:
"Nicol Bolas destroyed my world. I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life, no matter how dangerous."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

quotes.name: Mad Auntie
quotes.flavor: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

quotes.name: Memory Lapse
quotes.flavor:
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?"
—Reveka, wizard savant

quotes.name: Call of the Conclave
quotes.flavor: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

quotes.name: Aven Fleetwing
quotes.flavor:
"It was too fast, even for our veteran archers. They might as well have been blowing it kisses."
—Vulok, elvish archer

quotes.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
quotes.flavor: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

quotes.name: Embrace the Unknown
quotes.flavor: "Everyone's gotta die somehow. I'll be damned if I meet my end cowering in some cellar."

quotes.name: Silver Myr
quotes.flavor: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

quotes.name: Phantom Warrior
quotes.flavor: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

quotes.name: Pentagram of the Ages
quotes.flavor: A mirror, a shield, a promise, a great distance, and a kind word—five ways to avoid harm.

quotes.name: Rohirrim Lancer
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Dire deeds awake, dark is it eastward. Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!"
—Théoden

quotes.name: Emrakul's Hatcher
quotes.flavor: Wordlessly it leads its abhorrent brood.

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Repulse
quotes.flavor: "You aren't invited."

quotes.name: Tokka & Rahzar, Terrible Twos
quotes.flavor: "Master say have fun!"

quotes.name: Spitting Dilophosaurus
quotes.flavor: "Nice boy . . . nice boy. Nice dinosaur!"

quotes.name: Mishra's Bauble
quotes.flavor:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"I love old things. They make me feel sad."
—Sally Sparrow

quotes.name: Trained Armodon
quotes.flavor: Armodons are trained to step on things. Enemy things.

quotes.name: Syphon Essence
quotes.flavor: The third step in creating a skaab requires draining the body of blood and replacing it with *viscus vitae*, a mixture of angel's blood and lamp oil.

quotes.name: Dragonlord's Servant
quotes.flavor: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

quotes.name: Pack Mastiff
quotes.flavor: Their loyalty is not to any master, but to the pack.

quotes.name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
quotes.flavor: Some mages forsake their scrolls and libraries to learn at the feet of ancient trees and sacred stones.

quotes.name: Swarm Intelligence
quotes.flavor: The Locust God's children were numberless, relentlessly eating away every trace of the city's protection.

quotes.name: Artifact Blast
quotes.flavor: The first line of defense against Urza and Mishra, the artifact blast achieved widespread fame until an unlucky mage discovered it was useless on the devices the brothers had already created.

quotes.name: Moonglove Extractor
quotes.flavor: Concentrating moonglove flowers into deadly moonglow poison is a revered but fleeting position for Lorwyn elves.

quotes.name: Terra Stomper
quotes.flavor: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

quotes.name: Abyssal Hunter
quotes.flavor: Some smiles show cheer; some merely show teeth.

quotes.name: Windborn Muse
quotes.flavor: A single glimpse was enough to compel Captain Velkarne to lay down his sword and take up the poet's quill.

quotes.name: Fog Bank
quotes.flavor:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

quotes.name: Brago, King Eternal
quotes.flavor: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

quotes.name: Lava Spike
quotes.flavor: Some kami attacks during the war were rife with trickery, subterfuge, and subtlety, draining hope and pride from the mortal world. Other attacks were a lot more straightforward.

quotes.name: Woodland Stream
quotes.flavor:
"Bolas's power on this plane can't be absolute. Look around you."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Verdigris
quotes.flavor:
"Only the most sophisticated inventions can survive nature's unsophisticated motivations."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Unmoored Ego
quotes.flavor: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: She soars on wings of Serra's light, her sword of faith meting out justice to the wicked.

quotes.name: Extravagant Spirit
quotes.flavor: The fewer your possessions, the fewer your worries.

quotes.name: Elvish Skysweeper
quotes.flavor: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

quotes.name: Chastise
quotes.flavor:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Glen Elendra Liege
quotes.flavor: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.

quotes.name: Feign Death
quotes.flavor: A drastic measure for dangerous times.

quotes.name: Spiketail Drake
quotes.flavor: "The spell will have to wait," said Alexi, pointing up. "Drakes."

quotes.name: Oathsworn Vampire
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"My conquistadors are never slain, merely laid to rest."
—Queen Miralda the Pious

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Defibrillating Current
quotes.flavor:
A small shock to save a life, a large one to take it away.
—Mardu healer's adage

quotes.name: Knight of Glory
quotes.flavor: "I will uphold the law, and no manner of foe will stop me."

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: All through the winter Sam remained as patient as he could. Spring surpassed his wildest hopes.

quotes.name: Screeching Phoenix
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: Its wings are a heavenly inferno that sets the world ablaze.

quotes.name: Flaming Fist Officer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Get the remaining citizens to safety! These miscreants have an appointment with my spear."

quotes.name: Floodgate
quotes.flavor:
"Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!"
—Makht, goblin casualty

quotes.name: Vraska's Finisher
quotes.flavor: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."

quotes.name: Crusader of Odric
quotes.flavor: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

quotes.name: Wallop
quotes.flavor: In Yavimaya, flying low to join a battle can be a costly mistake.

quotes.name: Yavimaya Ancients
quotes.flavor:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Shrieking Affliction
quotes.flavor: A gargoyle's voice reaches pitches that will shatter glass and warp bone.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Hewed Stone Retainers
quotes.flavor:
"Their origins are shrouded in mystery. I believe they are the protectors of the lost secrets of our world."
—Jilaya, Temur whisperer

quotes.name: Kitsune Bonesetter
quotes.flavor:
"He kept generations whole before the Kami War, and now he turns his century of wisdom to healing the latest casualties."
—Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

quotes.name: Stormkeld Vanguard // Bear Down
quotes.flavor: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

quotes.name: Resentful Revelation
quotes.flavor: "The Jenova Project resulted in my conception."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Negator
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: They exist to cease.

quotes.name: Burn Bright
quotes.flavor:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Stoneforge Acolyte
quotes.flavor: "The stone speaks. We are merely interpreters."

quotes.name: Stonehoof Chieftain
quotes.flavor: The pounding of his followers' hearts matched the beat of his hooves, and their voices echoed his bellows.

quotes.name: Murmuring Phantasm
quotes.flavor:
"The most insidious thing in the world is nonsense that sounds just plausible enough to listen to."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"We have barely begun to learn the secrets of the Fourth People. Every remnant of their presence, however cryptic, is a gift."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

quotes.name: Kaalia of the Vast
quotes.flavor: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

quotes.name: Elusive Tormentor // Insidious Mist
quotes.flavor: Older vampires are usually more cautious than the newly-sired, calling upon ancient magic for which neonates lack patience.

quotes.name: Baneful Omen
quotes.flavor: "Ah, again it does not bode well for you."

quotes.name: Dauntless Onslaught
quotes.flavor:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

quotes.name: Typhoid Rats
quotes.flavor: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

quotes.name: Windrider Wizard
quotes.flavor: "It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."

quotes.name: Kraul Foragers
quotes.flavor:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying

quotes.name: Gerrard's Verdict
quotes.flavor: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

quotes.name: Spawnbed Protector
quotes.flavor:
"They are mere vestiges of the titan's true form. Their deaths are but a brief respite."
—Ugin

quotes.name: Roiling Regrowth
quotes.flavor:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Timeless Lotus
quotes.flavor: Urza exploited nature to power his war machines; in time, nature exploited his war machines to renew itself.

quotes.name: Jace's Sanctum
quotes.flavor:
"For all our lofty talk of keeping watch, we had no idea what we were getting into."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Dueling Grounds
quotes.flavor: "You think you can stop me?" hissed Tsabo. "I think I can kill you," replied Gerrard.

quotes.name: Pikemen
quotes.flavor: "As the cavalry bore down, we faced them with swords drawn and pikes hidden in the grass at our feet. 'Don't lift your pikes 'til I give the word,' I said." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

quotes.name: Falkenrath Reaver
quotes.flavor:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Nantuko Elder
quotes.flavor:
Plant a field with wishes, and you will grow more wishes.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Alms Collector
quotes.flavor: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

quotes.name: Patagia Golem
quotes.flavor: Its wings were only designed to be ornamental, but it learned to use them on its own.

quotes.name: Pollenbright Druid
quotes.flavor: You think the pollen is bright? Wait till you see the bees!

quotes.name: The Master, Multiplied
quotes.flavor: "Breaking news! I'm everyone. And everyone in the world is me!"

quotes.name: Grave Peril
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes the grave does not wait for death before relishing its feast of flesh and bones."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

quotes.name: Metalwork Colossus
quotes.flavor: "I've come to save the world!"

quotes.name: Sightless Ghoul
quotes.flavor: It blindly marches on Thraben's gates, guided by its master's direful will.

quotes.name: Tangleclaw Werewolf // Fibrous Entangler
quotes.flavor:
"What has long, flesh-rending claws and enormous, bone-crushing teeth?"
—Halana, Kessig ranger

quotes.name: Gurmag Rakshasa
quotes.flavor: "It's a pity to hoard life essence in a form so weak. Give it to me."

quotes.name: No Mercy
quotes.flavor:
"We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

quotes.name: Goldenglow Moth
quotes.flavor: Ordinary moths follow it, drawn to its light.

quotes.name: Egon, God of Death // Throne of Death
quotes.flavor: Egon ages backward, his wisdom soured by youthful spite.

quotes.name: Forced March
quotes.flavor: The Caterans call it a screening process. The dead are in no condition to argue.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor:
"This royal ring is a small thing, but it is everything. My birthright, the symbol of my home."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Punk Frogs
quotes.flavor: "Weirdo ninjas got some nerve showing up on our turf. Sayin' they don't wanna fight but they got swords and stuff. Heh."

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

quotes.name: Syphon Flesh
quotes.flavor: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Brownie
quotes.flavor:
"I've been insulted by drunks in a hundred inns, but never as skillfully or annoyingly as by those blasted Brownies."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

quotes.name: Singe-Mind Ogre
quotes.flavor: Even the balmgivers of Bant couldn't heal the incurables, but sharing their torment helped.

quotes.name: Cathar's Call
quotes.flavor: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.

quotes.name: Threaten
quotes.flavor: Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

quotes.name: Confiscation Coup
quotes.flavor: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."

quotes.name: Burnished Hart
quotes.flavor:
"The natural world has already solved our problems. Our challenge is to replicate the elegance of its solutions."
—Tawnos

quotes.name: Wretched Banquet
quotes.flavor:
"The meek inherit nothing."
—Sedris, the Traitor King

quotes.name: Temporal Spring
quotes.flavor: One splash of the spring's water knocks you clear into last week.

quotes.name: Sensor Splicer
quotes.flavor: With clarity of vision comes clarity of function.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Magus of the Wheel
quotes.flavor: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

quotes.name: Blue Elemental Blast
quotes.flavor: Nothing escapes a sharp mind.

quotes.name: Epicure of Blood
quotes.flavor: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

quotes.name: Deep Analysis
quotes.flavor: "The specimen seems to be broken."

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

quotes.name: Three-Headed Goblin
quotes.flavor: It's true that two heads are better than one, but after that you run into diminishing returns.

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

quotes.name: The Third Doctor
quotes.flavor: "It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."

quotes.name: Corrupt
quotes.flavor: One misstep in the swamp and the evil that sleeps beneath will rise to find you.

quotes.name: Ghostly Flicker
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Lizard, Connors's Curse
quotes.flavor: Dr. Curt Connors used lizard DNA to regrow his missing arm, but it didn't stop there.

quotes.name: River Serpent
quotes.flavor: Though the Luxa River brings life to Naktamun, it's not without dangers.

quotes.name: Temur Tawnyback
quotes.flavor:
"He just kind of followed me home one day. I mean, could you say no to this face?"
—Karasi, Mistrise provisioner

quotes.name: Stone Haven Outfitter
quotes.flavor: The makers and menders are the first called to battle and the last to leave.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Obliterator
quotes.flavor: Take everything from them. Lives. Flesh. The very gorund they walk on. Only then will your victory be compleat.

quotes.name: Foil
quotes.flavor: Among wizards, poor timing is the most consistent mistake.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: Apocalypse Chime
quotes.flavor:
"One day, or another, perhaps I shall ring my pretty chime . . . loudly, so that all may hear."
—Grandmother Sengir

quotes.name: Angel of Mercy
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

quotes.name: Reshape
quotes.flavor:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

quotes.name: Merchant of Venom
quotes.flavor: Ulna Alley is a maze of market stalls where anything can be purchased for the right price.

quotes.name: Disowned Ancestor
quotes.flavor: Long after death, the spirits of the Disowned continue to seek redemption among their Abzan kin.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Nameless Inversion
quotes.flavor: Just as a changeling's influence can have dramatic effects, so too can its sudden withdrawal.

quotes.name: Druidic Ritual
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Bone, root, and seed—the past, the present, and future in one handful of earth.

quotes.name: Catalog
quotes.flavor:
"The appearance of these warped stones throughout the provinces is too pervasive to be random. More evidence is needed to determine the reason behind them."
—Tamiyo's journal

quotes.name: Ghitu Slinger
quotes.flavor: If you survive a slinger attack, the slinger wished you to live.

quotes.name: Copycrook
quotes.flavor: The best hiding places are other people.

quotes.name: Finale of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

quotes.name: Call the Bloodline
quotes.flavor: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

quotes.name: Thunderbreak Regent
quotes.flavor: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

quotes.name: Faerie Guidemother // Gift of the Fae
quotes.flavor: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
quotes.flavor: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

quotes.name: Energy Flux
quotes.flavor: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

quotes.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
quotes.flavor: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

quotes.name: Faramir, Steward of Gondor
quotes.flavor: "The last Steward of Gondor begs leave to surrender his office."

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Rancor
quotes.flavor: Hatred outlives the hateful.

quotes.name: Grazing Gladehart
quotes.flavor:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

quotes.name: Death Pits of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"Neither could I forget what I had read of these pits—that the *sudden* extinction of life formed no part of their most horrible plan."
—Edgar Allan Poe,
"The Pit and the Pendulum"

quotes.name: Informed Inkwright
quotes.flavor: "My inklings are ideal for gathering information. There's no place on Arcavios they can't reach."

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Thoughtweft Charge
quotes.flavor: United in mind, soul, and muscle.

quotes.name: Ghost Ship
quotes.flavor: Going down with the ship is just the beginning.

quotes.name: Mardu Warshrieker
quotes.flavor:
"No body can contain so much fury. It reminds me of another battle, long past."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Everlasting Torment
quotes.flavor: When night fell, the plane itself was scarred.

quotes.name: Dryad's Revival
quotes.flavor: "Pleased to meet you, Seven."
